{"metadata":{"description":"Persistent browser plugin for the DeepSeek Harness 3D whale desktop pet.","id":"gh:1334406550","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-whale-pet","slug":"rongzi5/dsh-whale-pet","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Persistent browser plugin for the DeepSeek Harness 3D whale desktop pet."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-whale-pet"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Persistent browser plugin for the DeepSeek Harness 3D whale desktop pet."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The plugin registers one additive `whale-pet` entry in `shell.overlay`. It renders the procedural wh"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ale directly with the bundled `three@0.147.0`; it does not use a CDN, an iframe, a host RPC, or a wo"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"rkspace-absolute path."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Behavior"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- Rests at the viewport edge and patrols only at long, randomized intervals.
- Looks toward the poin"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ter and shows a short heart reaction on hover or activation.
- Uses several body-shaped hit regions "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"for dragging instead of a rectangular canvas target.
- Uses a continuous model yaw, so look, drag, p"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"atrol, and celebration all follow their movement direction instead of snapping left/right.
- Runs sc"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"reen motion and Three.js rendering in one `requestAnimationFrame` loop.
- Uses exponential, non-over"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"shooting drag follow and frame-rate-independent release inertia.
- Integrates animation phase over t"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"ime so changing speed cannot jump the body, tail, or fins."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Interactions and persistence"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Click recap** — clicking the **body** cycles a speech bubble through the
name/days entry and rec"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ent session events (completed long turns, goal/plan
milestones, tool failures with tool name and exi"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"t code, typing greetings).
Other hit zones do something else: **tail** a heart plus an immediate
pat"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"rol, **dorsal** an immediate patrol, **fin** a bubble.
- **Right-click menu** — chat with the pet (L"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"LM, see below), inspect or
delete remembered facts ("鲸鲸记得什么…"), rename the pet, resize it, toggle
co"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"rner snapping, glide back to a corner, or hide it. The menu is
keyboard-accessible (Enter/Space) and"},{"id":"p9s7","text":" closes on outside click or Escape.
- **Corner snapping** — real drags (beyond the click threshold) "},{"id":"p9s8","text":"glide to the
nearest corner on release; toggle it from the menu.
- **Size** — the menu entry "调整大小…（"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"100%）" opens an inline slider control
(50%–150%, 5% steps) with −/＋ step buttons and a reset to the "},{"id":"p9s10","text":"authored size.
Size is **render-only**: it scales the pet box around its own anchor, so the
resting "},{"id":"p9s11","text":"edge, patrol path, drag clamping and celebration ellipse are
identical at every size — enlarging the"},{"id":"p9s12","text":" whale never changes where it goes.
The trade-off is deliberate: because the resting position is lef"},{"id":"p9s13","text":"t untouched
too, above 100% the tail can poke past the viewport edge while the pet rests
against it,"},{"id":"p9s14","text":" and below 100% the silhouette sits slightly inside the corner.
- **Drag dizziness** — a forceful dr"},{"id":"p9s15","text":"ag (at least 420px of pointer travel at an
average 550px/s) or a prolonged drag (at least 4.5s with "},{"id":"p9s16","text":"24px of travel)
leaves the whale dizzy for about 4s. It rolls belly-up, weakly wobbles, and
shows th"},{"id":"p9s17","text":"ree stars orbiting an ellipse around its belly with front/back depth.
Hover, click, context-menu, an"},{"id":"p9s18","text":"d further drag reactions stay locked until it
recovers; holds without movement and cancelled gesture"},{"id":"p9s19","text":"s do not trigger it.
- **`Ctrl`/`Cmd` + `Alt` + `W`** — toggle the pet's visibility from anywhere;
t"},{"id":"p9s20","text":"he shortcut works even when the pet is hidden.
- **Persistence** — the pet's name, position, size, h"},{"id":"p9s21","text":"idden state and snap
preference survive reloads through `localStorage` (guarded against private
[该节后"},{"id":"p9s22","text":"n state and snap
preference survive reloads through `localStorage` (guarded against private
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## LLM chat and memory"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The right-click **"和鲸鲸聊天…"** entry opens an inline input bubble next to
the pet (Enter to send, Esc/"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"outside click to close; 200-character input, no
transcript UI), and the pet replies in its speech bu"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"bble. Replies stream in
when the host supports SSE (`Accept: text/event-stream`); the same bubble
gr"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"ows as tokens arrive instead of popping a new one per delta. The bubble
carries a **model selector**"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" and a **reasoning
effort selector**: the model list comes from the DSH LLM service
(`GET /api/whale"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"-pet/models`), and models that expose multiple reasoning
levels (e.g. deepseek-reasoner low/high) sh"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"ow an effort dropdown. Choices
persist to `localStorage` (`dsh.whale-pet.chat-prefs.v1`) and ride al"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ong with
every request."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Architecture: the browser pet never talks to an upstream LLM directly — the
host-side entry of this "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"package registers the `/api/whale-pet` prefix on the
web server, and the client calls the same-origi"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"n `POST /api/whale-pet/chat`
endpoint. The API key stays on the server."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- `src/client/activity.ts` — pure mood/effect vocabulary and the view snapshot type.
- `src/client/m"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"otion.ts` — pure frame-rate-independent screen-space motion, including the celebration loop path and"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" corner snapping.
- `src/client/persistence.ts` — guarded `localStorage` state (name, position, size"},{"id":"p15s4","text":", hidden, snap preference, first-run date).
- `src/client/runtime/scheduler.ts` — the single `reques"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"tAnimationFrame` clock.
- `src/client/runtime/whale-pet-controller.ts` — owns the DOM listeners, sch"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"eduler, and per-frame rendering; composes the Three.js scene from `src/client/whale`.
- `src/client/"},{"id":"p15s7","text":"runtime/whale-pet-service.ts` — observable runtime service (`ctx.whalePet`) with activity, transient"},{"id":"p15s8","text":" effects, recap history and persisted state.
- `src/client/runtime/session-observer.ts` — subscribes"},{"id":"p15s9","text":" to the current session snapshot (with a low-frequency polling fallback) and maps session state to m"},{"id":"p15s10","text":"oods/effects and user typing.
- `src/client/whale/config.ts` — shared geometry/animation constants a"},{"id":"p15s11","text":"nd SVG contours.
- `src/client/whale/geometry.ts` — pure SVG/contour helpers and BufferGeometry buil"},{"id":"p15s12","text":"ders.
- `src/client/whale/materials.ts` — material factories, including the blue/white body-mask sha"},{"id":"p15s13","text":"der.
- `src/client/whale/animation.ts` — frame pose animation (swim, tail, fins, eyes, float, error/"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"sleep reactions).
- `src/client/whale/scene.ts` — `createWhaleScene` factory composing config, geome"},{"id":"p15s15","text":"try, materials and animation into a `WhaleScene` handle.
- `src/client/WhalePet.tsx` — thin view con"},{"id":"p15s16","text":"suming the service snapshot through `useSyncExternalStore`; owns the DOM focus listeners for typing "},{"id":"p15s17","text":"detection, the context menu and the chat bubble (model/effort selectors).
- `src/client/memory.ts` —"},{"id":"p15s18","text":" long-term memory store (facts + recent turns) with the `[记住]` extraction protocol, persisted throug"},{"id":"p15s19","text":"h the guarded storage channel.
- `src/client/llm.ts` — browser transport for the same-origin chat pr"},{"id":"p15s20","text":"oxy (`/api/whale-pet/chat`, `/api/whale-pet/models`), injectable for headless tests.
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
